title: 💪 Dev drapes a sheet over two chairs... why won't it stay up? #kids #fort #play
title_alts: 💪 Why does Dev's fort fall every single night... and what fixes it? #kids #fort #play
💪 Tonight Dev has one sheet, three chairs, and no roof yet... #kids #fort #play
refrain: Four corners, one roof, up up
description_hook: Dev has one bedsheet, a handful of chairs and until bedtime to get a roof over his head. The fix comes out of the laundry basket.

characters.name: Dev
characters.description: six years old, short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, yellow t-shirt with a rocket, grey shorts

scenes.narration: Tonight Dev wants his fort standing before bedtime. He chants it. Four corners, one roof, up up!
scenes.caption: आज रात देव को अपना किला तैयार चाहिए। चार कोने, एक छत, ऊपर ऊपर!
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stands on a rug in a small living room holding a folded white bedsheet, facing two wooden dining chairs he has pulled apart. A table lamp glows warm and the window behind him is dark with rain.

scenes.narration: He drapes the sheet over two chair backs. It slides off, twice.
scenes.caption: वह चादर दो कुर्सियों पर डालता है। वह दो बार फिसल जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stretches a white bedsheet across the backs of two wooden dining chairs in the living room while one end of the sheet slips down to the rug. Warm lamp light, dark rainy window.

scenes.narration: Dev stacks books on the edges. It sags lower. Say ‘hold’ with him.
scenes.caption: देव किनारों पर किताबें रखता है। और झूल जाती है। उसके साथ बोलो — पकड़।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, kneels on the rug pressing thick picture books onto the edges of a white bedsheet that hangs low and baggy between two wooden chairs in the living room. Warm lamp light from one side.

scenes.narration: His sister wants that chair too. Only three left. The sheet drops and breaks his cup. Four corners, one roof, up up!
scenes.caption: बहन को भी वही कुर्सी चाहिए। गिलास टूट जाता है। चार कोने, एक छत, ऊपर ऊपर!
scenes.image_brief: A younger girl in pyjamas pulls one wooden dining chair away toward a row of dolls on the living room floor, while Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, watches the white bedsheet collapse and knock a plastic cup so water spreads across the rug. Warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Dev grabs the laundry pegs. He clips sheet to chair, corner by corner. Pegs are not fort tools.
scenes.caption: देव कपड़े की क्लिप लाता है। कोना-कोना चादर कुर्सी से जोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, stands on tiptoe pinching a wooden clothes peg onto the corner of a white bedsheet where it meets a wooden chair back, a fistful of more pegs in his other hand, in the living room. Warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Four pegs, one roof, no sag. Count them out loud with Dev. The rain sounds far away.
scenes.caption: चार क्लिप, एक छत, कोई झोल नहीं। देव के साथ जोर से गिनो। बारिश दूर लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, sits under a taut white bedsheet roof held up by four wooden clothes pegs, three chairs around him, in the living room. The lamp shines through the sheet and fills the space with soft light.

scenes.narration: Dev grins under the blanket. Four corners, one roof, up up!
scenes.caption: देव कंबल के नीचे मुस्कुराता है। चार कोने, एक छत, ऊपर ऊपर!
scenes.image_brief: Dev, a six-year-old boy with short straight black hair, one missing front tooth, a yellow t-shirt with a rocket on it and grey shorts, lies inside the finished bedsheet fort pulling a striped blanket up to his chin, smiling wide, pegged sheet corners above him. Soft warm lamp glow inside the fort and the living room dark beyond.

title: 😮 Aarav reaches for the last fire truck and someone else gets it... #kids #toys #play
title_alts: 😮 What does Aarav do when red boots grab the only fire truck? #kids #toys #play
😮 Aarav, one fire truck, five minutes, and a girl in red boots... #kids #toys #play
description_hook: There is one red fire truck on the toy library shelf and two children who want it. Aarav does not wait for the timer.

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: five years old, short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee, blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt

scenes.narration: At the toy library Aarav wants the last fire truck. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: टॉय लाइब्रेरी में आरव को वह आखिरी दमकल चाहिए। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, stands in a bright toy library room of low shelves, staring up at a single red metal fire truck on the middle shelf. Daylight comes through tall windows.

scenes.narration: He reaches for it. A girl in red boots gets there first. Make the siren with Aarav anyway.
scenes.caption: वह हाथ बढ़ाता है। लाल बूट वाली लड़की पहले पहुँच जाती है। आरव के साथ सायरन बजाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, stretches both hands toward a shelf while a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress lifts the red metal fire truck away first. Bright toy library with low shelves and tall windows.

scenes.narration: The turn timer shows five minutes. She wants it too, and the ladder snaps off in the tug.
scenes.caption: टाइमर में बस पाँच मिनट हैं। उसे भी वही चाहिए, और खींचातानी में सीढ़ी टूट जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, and a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress both grip the red metal fire truck on the toy library floor, a small broken plastic ladder piece lying beside them and a round turn timer on the shelf behind. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Aarav trades. He offers his tunnel blocks for the back seat, and calls it out. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: आरव सौदा करता है। पिछली सीट के बदले अपनी सुरंग देता है। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, kneels holding out a double handful of blue plastic tunnel blocks toward a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress, who holds the red metal fire truck. Scattered blocks on the bright toy library floor.

scenes.narration: The truck rolls through a blue tunnel, two hands steering. Shout ‘go’ out loud with them. Aarav feels enormous.
scenes.caption: गाड़ी नीली सुरंग से निकलती है, दो हाथ संभाल रहे हैं। उनके साथ जोर से बोलो — चलो!
scenes.image_brief: The red metal fire truck rolls through an arch built of blue plastic blocks on the toy library floor, with Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, and a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress each keeping one hand on it, both laughing. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Two drivers, one siren, one bent ladder. One truck, two drivers, go!
scenes.caption: दो ड्राइवर, एक सायरन, एक मुड़ी सीढ़ी। एक गाड़ी, दो ड्राइवर, चलो!
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a five-year-old boy with short curly black hair, a plaster on his left knee and blue dungarees over a striped orange shirt, sits shoulder to shoulder with a girl in red rubber boots with two short braids and a green dress on the toy library floor, the red metal fire truck with its bent ladder parked between them among blue blocks. Warm late afternoon light through the tall windows.

title: 😤 Sana throws her paper plane hard and it dives into the grass... #kids #paperplane #play
title_alts: 😤 Why does Sana's paper plane dive while her cousin's flies far? #kids #paperplane #play
😤 Sana's last sheet of paper, one park lawn, and lunch soon... #kids #paperplane #play
refrain: Fold it, throw it, fetch it back
description_hook: Sana wants the longest throw on the park lawn, and her paper plane keeps nose-diving into the grass. Her fix changes what she is even aiming for.

characters.name: Sana
characters.description: seven years old, two high ponytails with yellow bands, green t-shirt, denim shorts, grass stain on one knee

scenes.narration: On the park lawn Sana wants one record throw before lunch. Fold it, throw it, fetch it back.
scenes.caption: साना को लंच से पहले सबसे दूर वाला थ्रो चाहिए। मोड़ो, फेंको, वापस लाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, stands on a wide park lawn holding a freshly folded white paper plane above her shoulder, a picnic blanket with a basket behind her. Bright midday sun, long grass.

scenes.narration: She folds a sharp nose and throws hard. It dives into the grass. Count them out loud.
scenes.caption: वह तेज नोक बनाकर जोर से फेंकती है। जहाज घास में गिर जाता है। जोर से गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, stands with her arm still extended on the park lawn while a white paper plane with a sharp folded nose lies stuck point-down in the grass a few steps away. Bright midday sun.

scenes.narration: Her cousin's plane flies twice as far. He wants the last paper too, and her wing rips.
scenes.caption: चचेरे भाई का जहाज दोगुना दूर जाता है। उसे भी आखिरी कागज चाहिए, और पंख फट जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A taller boy in a blue cap on the park lawn watches his own paper plane glide away over the grass, while Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, holds her own plane with one wing torn along the fold, a single sheet of paper on the picnic blanket between them. Bright midday sun.

scenes.narration: Sana stops chasing distance. She bends both wing tips upward, chanting. Fold it, throw it, fetch it back.
scenes.caption: साना दूरी की होड़ छोड़ देती है। पंखों के सिरे ऊपर मोड़ती है। मोड़ो, फेंको, वापस लाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, kneels on the park lawn bending the two back corners of a paper plane's wings upward with her thumbs, mouth open mid-chant. Bright midday sun, grass around her knees.

scenes.narration: The plane curves out and lands beside her shoe. Call it in with Sana. She laughs.
scenes.caption: जहाज घूमकर उसके जूते के पास आ गिरता है। साना के साथ उसे बुलाओ। वह हँस पड़ती है।
scenes.image_brief: A white paper plane with upturned wing tips swings around in a wide curve over a park lawn and settles on the grass right next to the trainer of Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, who is laughing with both arms out. Bright midday sun.

scenes.narration: Sana bends the tips and grins. Fold it, throw it, fetch it back.
scenes.caption: साना सिरे फिर मोड़कर मुस्कुराती है। मोड़ो, फेंको, वापस लाओ।
scenes.image_brief: Sana, a seven-year-old girl with two high ponytails tied with yellow bands, a green t-shirt, denim shorts and a grass stain on one knee, stands on the park lawn smiling wide while she folds up the wing tips of her paper plane again, the taller boy in the blue cap now watching her from the picnic blanket. Warm afternoon sun.

title: 😬 Kabir offers a bottle cap to join the marble race... then what? #kids #marbles #play
title_alts: 😬 How does Kabir get into the courtyard marble race with no marbles? #kids #marbles #play
😬 Kabir, three marbles short, and one lane left in the courtyard... #kids #marbles #play
refrain: Three marbles in, one rolls out
description_hook: Entry to the courtyard marble race costs three marbles, and Kabir has none. So he asks the big kids for something else entirely.

characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: six years old, close-cropped black hair, red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts, one sandal strap undone

scenes.narration: In the courtyard Kabir wants into the marble race. Three marbles in, one rolls out.
scenes.caption: आँगन में कबीर को कंचों की रेस में शामिल होना है। तीन कंचे अंदर, एक बाहर।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, stands at the edge of a paved apartment courtyard with empty open hands, watching three older children crouched over two chalk lanes drawn on the ground. Late afternoon sun, long shadows.

scenes.narration: He offers a bottle cap instead. The big kids say no.
scenes.caption: वह बदले में बोतल का ढक्कन देता है। बड़े बच्चे मना कर देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, holds out a blue bottle cap on his flat palm toward three older children who keep their marbles cupped against their chests, on the paved apartment courtyard beside the chalk lanes. Late afternoon sun.

scenes.narration: Kabir digs the flowerbed. One chipped marble. Count it out loud.
scenes.caption: कबीर क्यारी में कंचे ढूँढता है। एक टूटा कंचा। जोर से गिनो।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, crouches in a dusty flowerbed at the edge of the apartment courtyard, pinching a single chipped green marble between finger and thumb, soil on his knuckles. Low warm sunlight.

scenes.narration: Another kid wants that lane too. Two lanes left, and Kabir's marble cracks.
scenes.caption: एक और बच्चे को वही लेन चाहिए। दो लेन बचीं, और कबीर का कंचा चटक जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A child in a yellow t-shirt steps into one of the two chalk lanes on the apartment courtyard floor, while Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, looks down at his chipped green marble lying split in two pieces against a concrete step. Late afternoon sun.

scenes.narration: Three marbles in, one rolls out. Kabir still has none, and the race starts.
scenes.caption: तीन कंचे अंदर, एक बाहर। कबीर के पास एक भी नहीं, और रेस शुरू।
scenes.image_brief: Three older children count marbles into a dented tin lid beside a chalk starting line on the apartment courtyard floor, while Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, stands just behind the line with his hands empty and open. Long evening shadows.

scenes.narration: Kabir asks differently. Not can I race, but can I build the track?
scenes.caption: कबीर सवाल बदल देता है। खेलने दो नहीं — तुम्हारा ट्रैक बना दूँ?
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, talks to three older children while pointing at a long cardboard poster tube leaning against the apartment courtyard wall, all of them turning to look at it. Warm evening light.

scenes.narration: He bends a poster tube into a ramp. Six racers lend a marble. Kabir is in.
scenes.caption: वह नली को ढलान बना देता है। छह खिलाड़ी एक-एक कंचा देते हैं। कबीर अंदर है।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, kneels holding a long cardboard poster tube propped on a brick as a slope, six marbles rolling down it onto the apartment courtyard floor while older children lean in around him. Golden evening light.

scenes.narration: Kabir calls the start. Say it with him. Three marbles in, one rolls out.
scenes.caption: कबीर शुरुआत की आवाज देता है। उसके साथ बोलो। तीन कंचे अंदर, एक बाहर।
scenes.image_brief: Kabir, a six-year-old boy with close-cropped black hair, a red football shirt with a white number seven, blue shorts and one sandal strap undone, stands at the top of the propped poster tube with one hand raised high, calling the start while children crouch along the chalk lanes below and a tin lid of marbles sits beside his foot. Warm sunset light across the apartment courtyard.
